Autonomous Floor Cleaning Robot - Commercial Floor Scrubber Essential Cookies Performance Cookies Targeting Cookies Essential Cookies Necessary cookies make sure the site is able to run and includes your site preferences. Performance Cookies These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance. Targeting Cookies These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising. Learn more ‘Reduces up to 80% of labor hours spent cleaning...’ “We’re excited to deploy additional Neos at DHL warehouses across the globe, propelling our digitalization journey forward. Floor-cleaning robots, while a simple innovation, reduce up to 80% of labor hours spent cleaning. This frees up our staff to engage in more value-adding, customer-centric work while driving our Strategy 2025 digitalization agenda forward.” Matthias Heutger, Senior Vice President, Global Head of Innovation & Commercial Development, DHL ‘The data analytics capability is really driving decisions...’ “If it can be measured, it can be improved. What really sold us on this particular unit was the phenomenal dashboarding [Avidbots Command Center] that comes along with it. It’s one thing to have an active unit cleaning and doing what you would expect it to do. But the data analytics capability is really driving decisions.” Brian Cobb, Chief Innovation Officer, CVG ‘Has doubled cleaning team productivity...’ “Deploying Neo at our warehouse has doubled cleaning team productivity and delivered a morale boost, allowing them to focus on additional tasks while the robot takes care of the floors.” Dan Souwand, VP Equipment, Systems & Warehousing, Christie Lites ‘Is going to make a world of difference...’ “The most important thing for us to think about is the health, safety and well-being of our students, teachers, and staff as they return to schools this fall. A solution like Neo that cleans more effectively, efficiently and gives my custodial team more time to focus on areas that students are touching frequently, is going to make a world of difference as we enter this new world of education.” Craig Henry, Southern Region School District Superintendent Advanced robotics. Advanced cleaning. When only the highest cleaning quality standards are acceptable, our robots' proven reliability and durability ensure your facility stays clean. Rugged construction, extended runtime, separate cleaning solution and recovery tanks — you can rely on Avidbots’ solutions to deliver a cleaner, more productive facility. Learn more The best autonomous clean in the industry Avidbots Autonomy provides an advanced suite of features Menu Advanced dynamic planning Real-time obstacle avoidance Intervention-free operation A 360° view of the environment Powered by Avidbots Autonomy, our proprietary AI software, our robots deliver a fully autonomous clean while handling environment changes with ease . When you choose our robots, your facility is mapped and a cleaning plan is generated. From that point forward, the robot’s onboard sensor suite examines the space at the beginning of each cleaning, comparing what it looks like in real time versus the original cleaning plan. The robot then determines the best cleaning route to maximize cleaning productivity while minimizing human intervention every time. Neo, Neo 2W, and Kas are unmatched in obstacle avoidance . Using a variety of sensors, Avidbots Autonomy consistently evaluates real-time incoming data to help our robots avoid anyone or anything and stop when unexpected obstacles appear, helping to keep the operating environment safe. Every time you press 'go', you can rest assured our robots will do just that. Thanks to Avidbots Autonomy, detailed cleaning plans, and real-time obstacle avoidance, our robots ensure intervention-free operation . In rare instances where the robot requires additional guidance, the Avidbots Remote Assistance team assists you with getting back on track using real-time data from the onboard sensors. An industry-leading suite of lidar (light detection and ranging) and 3D sensors provide Avidbots Autonomy with a 360° view of its surroundings. With this constant stream of information and data, our robots make real-time safety and navigational decisions.
